info.name: Countersign Spike (PayPal sandbox)
info.description: Technical spike for Countersign: vault > authorize > custom_id round-trip > capture/void > API-created dispute > evidence > adjudicate. Run folders in order. See SPIKE_README.md.

item.name: 00 Auth
item.description: Proves both sets of credentials work. Run first.

item.name: 00.2 Buyer-side access token (falls back to merchant app)

item.name: 01a Vault setup (before manual approval)
item.description: Creates a PayPal vault setup token. You must then open approve_url in a browser and approve as the sandbox buyer (MANUAL STEP).

item.name: 01a.1 Create setup token (save PayPal without purchase)

exec: pm.test('approve link returned', () => pm.expect(link, 'no approve link; is vaulting enabled on the app?').to.exist);
console.log('>>> MANUAL STEP: open this URL, log in as the sandbox buyer, approve:');

item.name: 01b Vault finalize (after manual approval)
item.description: Run only after you approved the setup token in the browser.

exec: pm.test('Setup token APPROVED (did you approve approve_url?)', () => pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('APPROVED'));
console.log('vaulted buyer email:', pp.email_address, '| payer_id:', pp.payer_id);
if (!be) { console.warn('buyer_email is not set. The vaulted email will be used for the dispute assertion.'); }
pm.test('vaulted email matches buyer_email (skipped if buyer_email unset)', () => { if (be) { pm.expect(String(pp.email_address || '').toLowerCase()).to.eql(be); } });

item.name: 02 Bind intent to payment (vault > authorize > capture)
item.description: Core of Countersign: mandate hash in custom_id, authorize then capture, tracking.

item.name: 02.1 Create order AUTHORIZE with vault_id + custom_id

exec: pm.test('Order is APPROVED or already authorized (vault payment accepted without buyer redirect)', () => pm.expect(j.status).to.be.oneOf(['APPROVED', 'COMPLETED']));
if (a.length) { pm.environment.set('authorization_id', a[0].id); console.log('authorization:', a[0].id, a[0].status); }

item.name: 02.3 Read back order: custom_id must equal mandate hash
03 Cooling-off path (authorize > void)
item.description: Proves the void path: money never moves when conformance fails.

item.name: 04 Disputes harness (create > evidence > adjudicate)
item.description: Needs a captured order from folder 02 and one-time buyer consent. 04.1 uses the buyer token + PayPal-Auth-Assertion.

exec: if (!usePayer && !buyerEmail) { throw new Error('buyer_email is empty. Set BUYER_EMAIL (sandbox buyer email) or run --request 01b.3 first.'); }
const subject = usePayer ? { iss: cid, payer_id: pm.environment.get('buyer_payer_id') } : { iss: cid, email: buyerEmail };
const jwt = b64u(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'none', typ: 'JWT' })) + '.' + b64u(JSON.stringify(subject)) + '.';
console.log('Auth-assertion subject:', usePayer ? 'payer_id' : 'email', '| iss (client id) ends with ...' + String(cid).slice(-6));
console.log('Using manually created dispute ' + manualDispute + ' (04.1 skipped)');
console.error('04.1 FAILED ' + pm.response.code + '. PayPal said: ' + pm.response.text());
let j = {}; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* non-JSON body */ }
console.log('status:', j.status, '| stage:', j.dispute_life_cycle_stage, '| due:', j.seller_response_due_date);
pm.test('dispute has status and stage', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.dispute_life_cycle_stage).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('200 OK, or already waiting for seller (4xx logged)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400, 422]));
